title: ISBLANK over a text column counts the BLANK row but not the empty-string row
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Empty, ISBLANK ( Empty[Txt] ) ) ) )

source.quote: An empty string and 0 are not considered blank by ISBLANK
source.supports: ISBLANK is FALSE for an empty string

derivation: Empty[Txt] holds '' (Id 1), BLANK (Id 2), x (Id 3). ISBLANK is TRUE only for the BLANK in row 2: 1 row.
